say:1:1631937001:1.text: I've been having trouble sleeping lately!
say:1:1631937001:1.male: I've been having trouble sleeping lately!
say:1:1631937001:1.female: I've been having trouble sleeping lately!

say:2:1631937002:1.text: I like it when it's quiet here, but it's been getting more and more crowded lately.
say:2:1631937002:1.source_cn: 好不容易清静了一段时间，结果最近这边人又多了起来。
say:2:1631937002:1.male: I like it when it's quiet here, but it's been getting more and more crowded lately.
say:2:1631937002:1.female: I like it when it's quiet here, but it's been getting more and more crowded lately.

say:3:1631937003:1.text: They're ditching the library for this place, thinking it's safer to study here.
say:3:1631937003:1.source_cn: 说什么图书馆有幽灵，来这边复习比较安全。
say:3:1631937003:1.male: They're ditching the library for this place, thinking it's safer to study here.
say:3:1631937003:1.female: They're ditching the library for this place, thinking it's safer to study here.

choice_prompt:4:1631937003.male: They're ditching the library for this place, thinking it's safer to study here.
choice_prompt:4:1631937003.female: They're ditching the library for this place, thinking it's safer to study here.

say:5:1631937004:1.text: Because this place is filled with portraits of mages.
say:5:1631937004:1.source_cn: 因为这里有很多魔法师画像。
say:5:1631937004:1.male: Because this place is filled with portraits of mages.
say:5:1631937004:1.female: Because this place is filled with portraits of mages.

say:6:1631937005:1.text: And they think they can keep the ghost away.
say:6:1631937005:1.source_cn: 或许幽灵不敢来这里捣乱。
say:6:1631937005:1.male: And they think they can keep the ghost away.
say:6:1631937005:1.female: And they think they can keep the ghost away.

say:7:1631937006:1.text: But they're just getting in my way!
say:7:1631937006:1.source_cn: 但他们这就是在给我捣乱！
say:7:1631937006:1.male: But they're just getting in my way!
say:7:1631937006:1.female: But they're just getting in my way!

say:8:1631937007:1.text: I feel like jumping up and whacking them right in the knees!
say:8:1631937007:1.source_cn: 等着，我一定要跳起来狠狠打他们的膝盖。
say:8:1631937007:1.male: I feel like jumping up and whacking them right in the knees!
say:8:1631937007:1.female: I feel like jumping up and whacking them right in the knees!

say:9:1631937008:1.text: I may look cute, but I'm no pushover!
say:9:1631937008:1.male: I may look cute, but I'm no pushover!
say:9:1631937008:1.female: I may look cute, but I'm no pushover!
